summary: Named as a lookout site in Greene County on the tnlandforms.us Georgia list; Wikipedia places the town of Siloam in Greene County. No source describes a tower or the site today.

facts.status_note: Only a tnlandforms.us list names this site. No source says whether a tower was built here or stands today.

evidence.supports: The source is a list of Georgia lookout towers
Lists a lookout site named siloam in Greene County, elevation 661 (no unit given)
The town of Siloam lies in Greene County

notes_for_editor: Confidence low. The only tower-specific source is the list entry, which gives no date, owner or description. Greene County is supported by the list and by the Wikipedia infobox. The 'datasheet DF2236' tag is unexplained; the cached list page links to NOAA datasheets, which were not checked. Search snippets (not read, not cited) mentioned a 97.5 m commercial antenna registered in Siloam and a Siloam Historic District; neither is a lookout. Thin story, about 60 words, because no build, staffing or fate evidence was found. Status and access in the brief stay unknown.
